001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.rulecmd.salvage.special;
002
003import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
004import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.CargoAPI;
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.InteractionDialogAPI;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.PlanetAPI;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.CommoditySpecAPI;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Entities;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.rulecmd.salvage.SalvageSpecialInteraction.SalvageSpecialData;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.rulecmd.salvage.SalvageSpecialInteraction.SalvageSpecialPlugin;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc;
012
013public class CargoManifestSpecial extends BaseSalvageSpecial {
014
015        
016        public static class CargoManifestSpecialData implements SalvageSpecialData {
017                public String commodityId = null;
018                public float min;
019                public float max;
020                public CargoManifestSpecialData(String commodityId, float min, float max) {
021                        this.commodityId = commodityId;
022                        this.min = min;
023                        this.max = max;
024                }
025                
026                public SalvageSpecialPlugin createSpecialPlugin() {
027                        return new CargoManifestSpecial();
028                }
029        }
030        
031        private CargoManifestSpecialData data;
032        
033        public CargoManifestSpecial() {
034        }
035        
036
037        @Override
038        public void init(InteractionDialogAPI dialog, Object specialData) {
039                super.init(dialog, specialData);
040                
041                data = (CargoManifestSpecialData) specialData;
042                
043                initManifest();
044        }
045
046        private void initManifest() {
047                
048                CommoditySpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getCommoditySpec(data.commodityId);
049                
050                if (spec == null) {
051                        initNothing();
052                        return;
053                }
054                
055                boolean debris = Entities.DEBRIS_FIELD_SHARED.equals(entity.getCustomEntityType());
056                String name = "sent to the $shortName";
057                if (debris) name = "searching through the debris";
058                if (entity instanceof PlanetAPI) {
059                        name = "sent to the surface";
060                }
061                
062                String text1 = "A cargo manifest found by the salvage crews " + name + " indicates " +
063                                                "the presence of a quantity of " + spec.getName().toLowerCase() + ", " +
064                                                "likely to be found if proper salvage operations are conducted.";
065                addText(text1);
066                
067                CargoAPI extra = Global.getFactory().createCargo(true); 
068                float quantity = data.min + (data.max - data.min) * random.nextFloat();
069                
070                if (Misc.isExtended()) {
071                        quantity *= Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_commoditySalvageDropFraction");
072                        if (quantity < 1f) quantity = 1f;
073                }
074                
075                quantity = Math.round(quantity);
076                extra.addCommodity(data.commodityId, quantity);
077                addTempExtraSalvage(extra);
078                
079                setDone(true);
080                setShowAgain(true);
081        }
082        
083        
084}
085
